When an existing checkpoint row is accidentally modified or replaced while retaining its provenance fields, this loop accepts it without comparing it to the immutable per-question `terminal-row.json` or recomputing the evaluation from the saved raw candidates. The row is then skipped during execution and its stored checks, status, attempts, and image hashes are passed directly into finalization, so checkpoint corruption can silently change the reported experiment result. Verify the terminal-row bytes or rescore each resumed row against the frozen source and truth before treating it as complete.
